It is protected Physical-AI runtime adaptation evidence, but it does not primarily optimize inference compute or latency.

historical_watchlist.title: MicroIntent: Intent-Based Placement Strategy for Microservice Application in the Compute Continuum Using LLMs
historical_watchlist.topic: edge/cloud/heterogeneous AI systems / compute continuum / LLM placement
historical_watchlist.why: MicroIntent uses LLMs to translate high-level business intent into placement decisions across a geographically distributed compute continuum. It is relevant to cloud-edge orchestration and heterogeneous serving, but current evidence is about placement usability/decision quality rather than AI inference throughput or energy.

historical_watchlist.title: CPR-IE:A Compression-Prediction-Resource Intelligence Efficiency Metric
historical_watchlist.topic: edge/cloud/heterogeneous AI systems / efficiency metric / deployment evaluation
historical_watchlist.why: CPR-IE proposes a deployment-oriented efficiency ordering that jointly accounts for compression, predictive quality and resource burden, with unit-invariant aggregation. It is useful as an evaluation lens for Efficient-ML comparisons, but it is a metric/protocol rather than an optimization technique.

historical_watchlist.title: On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Model Adaptation, an Effective Paradigm on Low-Quality Multimodal Data
historical_watchlist.why: Learns sample-wise distillation targets with a lightweight controller used only during training, preserving the compact student inference architecture and test-time cost while improving base-to-novel and cross-dataset transfer.

historical_watchlist.title: Broken on Arrival: Silently Defective LLM Artifacts in Public Model Registries and How to Catch Them
historical_watchlist.topic: quantization / deployment reliability / model registry QA
historical_watchlist.why: Execution-based auditing of 327 quantized GGUF artifacts finds silently defective official and community conversions that surface heuristics miss, and releases a quantized-model acceptance-testing tool. This is deployment QA rather than acceleration but is important low-bit infra lineage.

historical_watchlist.title: Think Wider: Mitigating Latent Rank Collapse in Implicit Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / implicit CoT / latent reasoning
historical_watchlist.why: WIDER is a training-time spectral regularizer for implicit CoT that leaves inference decoding unchanged while improving implicit-reasoning baselines and reducing latent redundancy. It targets reasoning efficiency without adding runtime machinery, but the abstract lacks direct latency/token savings.

historical_watchlist.title: Less Is Personal: Learning Minimal Sufficient User Profiles for Personalized Language Models
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / context compression / personalization
historical_watchlist.why: ENOUGH learns when to STOP adding retrieved user history, jointly optimizing utility, specificity and token cost, then invokes the frozen generator once. Across six personalization tasks it preserves utility while reducing unnecessary context, but the abstract does not state a single comparable token-reduction ratio.

historical_watchlist.title: What Eviction Destroys: A Restore-Counterfactual Audit of Forgetting in Agent Memory
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / memory eviction / evaluation
historical_watchlist.why: Introduces a per-question restore counterfactual that separates irreversible eviction loss from recoverable retrieval failure under token budgets. It is a useful diagnostic for agent-memory compression policies, though it is an audit methodology rather than an optimizer.

historical_watchlist.title: Miles v0.1: Production-Level Post-Training
historical_watchlist.topic: distributed training/inference / RL post-training / serving-training integration
historical_watchlist.why: Full-stack post-training system built around SGLang rollouts, Megatron/FSDP training and multiple weight-sync transports, with asynchronous agentic RL demonstrated on GLM-5.2 744B-A40B over 64 GB300 GPUs. Important open AI-infra evidence, though the abstract lacks a clean baseline speedup.

historical_watchlist.title: Rethinking Learned Occupancy in Autonomous Active Mapping with Observation-Gated Filtering
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / world models / active mapping
historical_watchlist.why: Shows that more accurate learned occupancy can still hurt closed-loop mapping, then adds an observation-gated planner-facing filter without retraining. This is protected Physical-AI evidence about online world-model correction, not direct inference acceleration.

historical_watchlist.title: Choosing the Right Language Mode at Inference Time for Multilingual Reliability
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / adaptive inference / compute routing
historical_watchlist.why: RAAI performs calibration-aware routing and uses a mid-layer risk index to gate sequential reasoning, allocating extra compute only when likely to help. It improves low-resource-language accuracy and calibration, but the abstract does not quantify compute saved.

historical_watchlist.title: PLUME: Parameter-Efficient Personalization of Large Language Models via Low-Rank User Modulation in Shared Subspaces
historical_watchlist.why: Uses a shared task subspace plus tiny per-user modulation matrices and rank-1 residuals, reducing per-user parameters by over 95% while matching or improving personalization baselines.

historical_watchlist.title: Learning Counterfactual World Models for Embodied Reasoning under Partial Observability
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / world models / planning
historical_watchlist.why: Counterfactual Latent World Models explicitly separate intervention outcomes under partial observability, improving planning success and reducing exploitative planning failures; the counterfactual-separability metric strongly tracks planning success. Protected world-model lineage, but not a compute optimization.

historical_watchlist.title: GLoRI: Closed-Loop Whole-Body Tracking with Global-Local Reference Interaction for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / humanoid control / closed-loop runtime
historical_watchlist.why: Closed-loop global-local controller reaches 100% held-out HuMoTo completion and transfers Isaac Gym to MuJoCo without fine-tuning, then runs a single real Unitree G1 policy over unseen objects. Protected Physical-AI runtime lineage without explicit inference-cost gains.

historical_watchlist.title: FANS: Federated Adaptive Network Search Learning for Heterogeneous Devices
historical_watchlist.topic: edge/cloud/heterogeneous AI systems / federated learning / elastic models
historical_watchlist.why: Learns a shared architecture space for heterogeneous clients rather than a tiny fixed model menu, expanding feasible subnetworks by orders of magnitude and improving accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across vision and BERT workloads.

historical_watchlist.title: Mind the Approximation: Fisher-Weighted SVD Compression for ViTs
historical_watchlist.why: FACTS plus constrained rank search improves ViT accuracy-efficiency under fixed FLOP budgets without finetuning, beating the strongest SVD baseline by up to 5.8 Top-1 points on Swin-B.

historical_watchlist.title: CALIPER: Clean Scenes Cannot Rank Physical Inference in Pretrained Visual Representations
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / representation evaluation / world models
historical_watchlist.why: CALIPER shows clean fixed-camera probes can falsely make random and pretrained encoders look equally physical, while randomized scenes expose a large spread in actionable prediction. Useful protected Physical-AI evaluation debt for choosing perception backbones.

historical_watchlist.title: Exploring the Genesis Platform Capabilities to Accelerate Scientific Discovery in OPAL
historical_watchlist.topic: edge/cloud/heterogeneous AI systems / cross-facility orchestration / managed AI services
historical_watchlist.why: DOE Genesis provides reusable managed execution, model distribution, governed LLM access, shared data and provenance across facilities; in a 40-day campaign it replaced roughly twelve hours of manual analysis with interactive queries returning in seconds to minutes.

historical_watchlist.title: Heat Kernel Textures: the Geodesic Gaussians That Do Not Splat
historical_watchlist.topic: video/image generation acceleration / 3D representation / memory efficiency
historical_watchlist.why: Heat Kernel Textures replace UV texture maps with intrinsic anisotropic heat kernels on mesh surfaces, explicitly targeting substantially lower texture-memory footprint while removing UV seams, distortion and wasted space. This is useful representation-efficiency lineage adjacent to Gaussian/3D rendering, but the abstract does not provide a single end-to-end rendering speedup.

historical_watchlist.title: Iris: Climbing to the Search Frontier
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / search agents / context management
historical_watchlist.why: Iris trains search agents with SFT-RL climbing and explicitly returns the hardest solved and most efficient rollouts to the next supervised stage. The evaluation isolates inference-time context management because it matters more than many reported system differences, making this strong agent-runtime lineage even though the abstract does not give a clean latency or token-reduction ratio.

historical_watchlist.title: Can AI Agents Detect and Repair Artifact Drift in Network Experiments?
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / agent runtimes / benchmark
historical_watchlist.why: NetArtifactBench evaluates 23 agent configurations across three general-purpose AI-agent runtimes with deterministic scoring over 5,980 outputs. It is not an acceleration paper, but it is a useful systems benchmark for comparing runtime behavior and failure modes in multi-artifact workflows.

historical_watchlist.title: AXON: A ROS 2 RMW with Shared-Memory/QUIC Transport and QKD/ML-KEM Key Establishment
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / robotics middleware / edge-cloud transport
historical_watchlist.why: AXON replaces DDS-backed ROS 2 middleware with scope-aware transports: POSIX shared-memory rings on-host and QUIC remotely, plus explicit key-establishment modes. This is protected Physical-AI runtime/infra evidence; the current paper deliberately limits claims and does not yet provide comparative performance numbers.

historical_watchlist.title: Data Efficient Sample Selection for In-Context Learning
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / in-context learning / sample selection
historical_watchlist.why: DearICL models demonstration selection as subset ranking and reports 8.08-15.9% accuracy gains over linear-bandit baselines with low sample complexity. It is relevant to efficient prompt/demo selection, although the abstract does not quantify prompt-token or wall-clock savings.

historical_watchlist.title: Compressed Recurrent Feedback in Tsetlin Machines: A Reproducible Boolean-FSM Study
historical_watchlist.topic: edge/cloud/heterogeneous AI systems / compact recurrent inference
historical_watchlist.why: Compresses 480 clause activations to 96 recurrent bits while keeping accuracy within about one point of raw feedback; raw feedback increases measured host execution time by 4.38x and 3.71x. The no-feedback control is competitive, so this is useful edge-inference evidence but not a strong canonical result.

historical_watchlist.title: ResidualAuth: What Authorization State Must Language Agents Preserve under Revocable Delegation?
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / agent memory / state compression
historical_watchlist.why: Shows a concrete lower-bound-style failure of overly compressed agent memory: a fixed 256-token summary solves at most 2/16 paired authorization cases, while exact ledger serializations fit held-out states at 768-1024 tokens and support correct decisions. Valuable negative evidence for how far agent runtime state can be compressed.

historical_watchlist.title: Optimizer Memory Schedules for Outscaling the Overtraining Axis
historical_watchlist.topic: distributed training/inference / optimizer efficiency / training compute
historical_watchlist.why: Systematically studies optimizer memory and training-horizon scaling from 51M to 253M parameters and 1x-256x overtraining. Muon and SOAP retain token-efficiency advantages while ADANA closes the gap at long horizons; useful training-efficiency lineage though the abstract lacks one clean wall-clock speedup.

historical_watchlist.title: Efficient Leakage-Free Neural Architecture Search under Leave-One-Subject-Out Evaluation
historical_watchlist.topic: edge/cloud/heterogeneous AI systems / neural architecture search / model compression
historical_watchlist.why: Block-based leakage-free NAS avoids fully nested O(N^2) search and reduces model parameters by up to 99.2% on BioVid while slightly improving mean accuracy. Good resource-efficiency evidence, but currently narrow in task/domain and lacks standardized GPU-hour reduction.

historical_watchlist.title: WeAgent-MMGenEdit: A Full-Stack Recipe for Multimodal Agentic Image Generation and Editing
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / video/image generation acceleration / agent runtime
historical_watchlist.why: Provides a full multimodal agent runtime with persistent evidence management plus post-training; a 30B-total/3B-active policy approaches a 1T-parameter agent. Relevant active-parameter/runtime lineage, but no direct latency or throughput ratio is given.

historical_watchlist.title: Map the Possibilities: Spatial Belief Fields for Language-Goal Aerial Navigation
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / closed-loop navigation / spatial memory
historical_watchlist.why: Maintains a task-conditioned spatial belief field and updates it online from partial observations rather than collapsing to one waypoint; on unseen CityNav it improves SPL from 19.63% to 30.43%. Protected Physical-AI lineage, but it is an effectiveness result rather than an inference-efficiency paper.

historical_watchlist.title: Dynamic Lagging for Simultaneous Translation
historical_watchlist.topic: LLM serving / efficient reasoning / latency-controlled generation
historical_watchlist.why: Fine-tunes Qwen3-8B for prefix-aware simultaneous translation and uses a single training-free confidence threshold to trace a continuous quality-latency frontier that outperforms wait-k and suffix-deletion controls. This is directly relevant to latency-aware LLM decoding, though the abstract does not report a universal wall-clock speedup.

historical_watchlist.title: Rethinking One-Shot Federated Graph Learning: Training-Free Statistical Estimation
historical_watchlist.topic: distributed training/inference / training-free learning / communication efficiency
historical_watchlist.why: SPEAR removes local GNN training entirely for one-shot federated graph learning and reports at least an order-of-magnitude speedup over all baselines, reaching several orders over generative/distillation methods. Strong efficiency evidence, but the workload is specialized graph FL rather than core foundation-model infra.

historical_watchlist.title: Inference-Time Nash Alignment
historical_watchlist.why: Replaces parameter-updating preference fine-tuning with inference-time Best-of-Nash and Nash Mirror Descent under general preferences. It is relevant as a no-fine-tuning alignment path, but the abstract provides no direct end-to-end compute or latency comparison.

historical_watchlist.title: DataFlex-RL: An Evaluation Platform for RLVR Data Policies
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / RLVR training systems / data efficiency
historical_watchlist.why: DataFlex-RL evaluates 13 RLVR data-policy configurations under a common GRPO recipe and finds no reproducible gain over uniform sampling at matched precision. This is useful negative systems evidence for avoiding unnecessary rollout-selection complexity in reasoning post-training.

historical_watchlist.title: Companion-style QA Assistance in Ego-Vision
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / streaming video memory / egocentric agents
historical_watchlist.why: BuddyVQA targets long-form egocentric streaming QA; MyBuddy adds a question filter and multi-level memory specifically to make QA and visual retrieval efficient in streaming settings. Protected Physical-AI/MLLM runtime lineage, but no explicit token or latency reduction is reported.

historical_watchlist.title: Noise Adaptive Streaming Audio-Visual Speech Token Enhancement for Robust Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Models
historical_watchlist.topic: multimodal/MLLM serving / streaming speech / modular adaptation
historical_watchlist.why: AV-STE is a streaming audio-visual token-restoration front-end that keeps the downstream Moshi speech LLM frozen, avoiding costly multimodal retraining while improving coherence under noise. Useful modular serving lineage, but the abstract gives no end-to-end latency or throughput comparison.

historical_watchlist.title: Temporal Self-Distillation: Learning Visual State Tracking in Videos Without Supervision
historical_watchlist.why: S3T uses denser temporal views as an internal teacher for a sparse-view student with shared weights, requiring no labels, separate teacher, or reward signal and adding no inference cost. It improves LLaVA-OneVision video-state tracking, though the efficiency gain is primarily training/data-side rather than measured serving speedup.

historical_watchlist.title: From Interaction Traces to Persistent Skills: Online Evolution for Computer-Use Agents
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / procedural memory / skill reuse
historical_watchlist.why: Converts interaction trajectories and evaluator feedback into a persistent versioned skill library while keeping the action-generation and grounding stack fixed. Across four OSWorld domains the evolving library improves post-warm-up evaluator scores by 5.7-18.6 points, providing useful evidence for reusable procedural memory without model updates.

historical_watchlist.title: Does Your Agent's Memory Survive a Model Upgrade? A Controlled Study of Memory Portability
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / memory portability / RAG migration
historical_watchlist.why: Controlled migration study shows fixed-schema KG memory transfers almost unchanged, compressed notes are highly model-coupled, and half-migrated embedding indexes forfeit most of the gain from full re-embedding. Important systems evidence for durable agent-memory formats and migration cost.

historical_watchlist.title: RAPTOR: Role-Aware Private Training for Mixture-of-Experts
historical_watchlist.topic: MoE systems/accelerators / distributed training / private fine-tuning
historical_watchlist.why: RAPTOR separates shared and expert optimization, uses expert-specific clipping/noise, and exploits parallel privacy composition across routed experts. It gives consistent utility gains on Switch Transformer, OLMoE and DeepSeek-VL2-Tiny under matched privacy budgets, but the abstract does not quantify training-time or memory savings.

historical_watchlist.title: Aplaud: Adaptive Personalized Low-Rank Decomposition for User-Specific LLM
historical_watchlist.topic: quantization / parameter-efficient adaptation / personalized LLM serving
historical_watchlist.why: Aplaud separates a frozen shared low-rank basis from compact per-user corrections and reports better generalization plus inference efficiency than LoRA-style personalized baselines. Relevant scalable personalization lineage, though the abstract omits a concrete memory/latency ratio.

historical_watchlist.title: Object-Aware Background-Controlled Editing via Weighted Velocity Guidance
historical_watchlist.why: OAVC performs object-localized velocity control directly during diffusion/rectified-flow inference with no retraining or base-model modification. It is relevant inference-time flow-control lineage, but the reported improvements are fidelity/stability rather than wall-clock acceleration.

historical_watchlist.title: CT-SAFR: Safe and Interpretable Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Autonomous Robots: A Multi-Layered Verification Framework for Trustworthy AI-Driven Robotic Decision Making
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / runtime verification / robot reasoning
historical_watchlist.why: CT-SAFR adds a multi-layer robot-reasoning verifier with 94.2% hallucination detection and sub-500 ms latency in a warehouse-robot case study. This is protected Physical-AI runtime-verification evidence, although the contribution is safety rather than acceleration.

historical_watchlist.title: MpSub: A Momentum p-Dimensional Subspace Trust-Region Method for Derivative-Free Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
historical_watchlist.topic: LLM training efficiency / memory-efficient fine-tuning / zeroth-order optimization
historical_watchlist.why: MpSub targets the activation/gradient memory burden of full-parameter LLM fine-tuning with derivative-free trust-region updates in a low-dimensional subspace and removes per-task learning-rate tuning. Useful training-memory lineage, but the abstract does not provide a clean end-to-end memory or wall-clock ratio.

historical_watchlist.title: Spillover-Aware Multi-Value Steering for Pluralistic LLM Alignment
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / activation steering / inference-time control
historical_watchlist.why: Derives a zero-cost geometric correction that decouples simultaneous activation-steering directions, requiring no fine-tuning, reward model, or manual prompt engineering. Relevant inference-time behavioral-control lineage, though the paper optimizes steering fidelity rather than serving latency.

historical_watchlist.title: Training-Free Task Vectors for LLM Behavioral Control
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / model editing / training-free adaptation
historical_watchlist.why: Maps activation steering vectors to rank-one weight-space edits using forward-pass statistics only, avoiding fine-tuning to discover task vectors while supporting add/subtract/composition operations. Strong adaptation-efficiency idea, but the abstract does not quantify deployment latency or memory savings.

historical_watchlist.title: ViBe: Visual Behavior Adaptation for Perceptive Humanoid Whole-Body Control
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / parameter-efficient robot adaptation / visual control
historical_watchlist.why: ViBe adapts pretrained humanoid motion trackers to perceptive control by extracting visual feedback and grafting it through low-rank adapters, enabling parameter-efficient post-training instead of rebuilding the controller. Protected Physical-AI adaptation lineage; abstract lacks a direct runtime or memory ratio.

historical_watchlist.title: FRAME: Factored Retrieval via Attribute Readouts for Object-Centric Scene Memory
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / scene memory / retrieval
historical_watchlist.why: FRAME factors language queries into attribute weights over a fixed object-centric scene memory, targeting persistent robot-memory retrieval without rerunning perception. Protected Physical-AI memory lineage, but the abstract focuses on retrieval quality rather than measured compute savings.

historical_watchlist.title: Qiushi Engine on AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / autonomous research agents / cost evaluation
historical_watchlist.why: Reports an end-to-end autonomous research-agent evaluation with explicit average benchmark cost of USD 15.209 per task and full execution traces across 40 hard tasks. Useful cost-aware agent-systems evidence, though it is primarily an engine evaluation rather than a new efficiency mechanism.

historical_watchlist.title: SAM3-O2D2: Zero-Shot Object Out-of-Distribution Detection by Object Class Prompting of the SAM3-Image Model
historical_watchlist.topic: multimodal/MLLM serving / efficient vision inference / OOD detection
historical_watchlist.why: The method explicitly replaces a prior zero-shot OOD pipeline whose inference requires computationally costly diffusion with a SAM3-image prompting route. This is relevant foundation-model inference-efficiency lineage, but the abstract does not provide a clean wall-clock speedup or energy ratio.

historical_watchlist.title: Ollama in the Wild: A Longitudinal Measurement of Exposed Ollama LLM Endpoints at Internet Scale
historical_watchlist.topic: LLM serving / deployment infrastructure / open-source ecosystem
historical_watchlist.why: A 365-day active measurement of self-hosted Ollama endpoints characterizes persistence, upgrade behavior, geography and hosting concentration across roughly 4.8M IP-day observations. It is not an acceleration method, but it is unusually direct systems evidence about real-world open LLM-serving deployment and upgrade behavior.

historical_watchlist.title: What Does an LLM-Agent Leaderboard Rank Actually Compare?
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / evaluation / cost-aware benchmarking
historical_watchlist.why: Shows that agent leaderboard conclusions can change with task mixture, measurement source and utility/cost rules, and proposes an estimand-aware pairwise procedure with uncertainty and practical margins. Useful for cost-aware agent-systems evaluation even though it is not itself a runtime optimization.

historical_watchlist.title: Procedural Memory Under Change: Reuse and Interference in Controlled Web Tasks
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / procedural memory / reuse under distribution shift
historical_watchlist.why: Controlled web-task experiments study when reusable procedural memory remains applicable after interface or task changes and when memory interferes. This is valuable negative systems evidence for agent skill reuse and memory portability, though no direct compute saving is claimed.

historical_watchlist.title: TokenMatch: 3D Mesh Correspondence Transformer with Curvature-Guided Tokenisation
historical_watchlist.why: TokenMatch replaces costly generative functional-map inference with a feed-forward transformer using curvature-guided tokenization and cross-attention, motivated explicitly by inference cost and generalization. Relevant token-efficiency lineage, but the abstract lacks a quantified speedup.

historical_watchlist.title: Dual-Layer Semantic-Spatial Belief Mapping for Aerial Object Goal Navigation
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / persistent spatial memory / VLM navigation
historical_watchlist.why: AeroBelief converts noisy frame-level VLM outputs into persistent semantic-spatial belief maps with separate intuition and evidence layers for aerial ObjectNav. Protected Physical-AI memory/runtime lineage; efficiency is architectural rather than measured as latency or FLOPs.

historical_watchlist.title: AirAnchor: Bridging Local and Global Spatial Information for Zero-Shot Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / local-global memory / aerial VLN
historical_watchlist.why: AirAnchor bridges online local representations and offline global memories using spatial anchors for zero-shot aerial VLN. It is protected Physical-AI memory/orchestration lineage, but the abstract focuses on navigation quality rather than measured inference efficiency.

historical_watchlist.title: RISE: Recursive Improvement via Self-Extrapolating Policy Distillation
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / RLVR post-training / self-distillation
historical_watchlist.why: RISE constructs a synthetic teacher directly from the model own RLVR trajectory and refreshes it every iteration, eliminating an external teacher or privileged conditioning while converting sparse outcome rewards into dense token-level targets. Strong reasoning-post-training efficiency lineage, though the abstract does not quantify wall-clock or token-cost savings.

historical_watchlist.title: SkillSpec: Intent-Masked Specification Reasoning for Agent Skill Correctness
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / reusable skills / agent infrastructure
historical_watchlist.why: SkillSpec treats reusable agent skills as specification-bearing artifacts, checks heterogeneous skill repositories under controlled context masks, and validates defects in an isolated sandbox. On 515 real-world skills it finds 763 confirmed defects across 239 skills. Important reusable-skill infrastructure lineage, albeit quality assurance rather than acceleration.

historical_watchlist.title: APPSim-Bench: Bridging Real-world Apps and Reproducible Evaluation for Mobile GUI Agents
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / GUI agents / reproducible runtime evaluation
historical_watchlist.why: APPSim-Bench provides 557 deterministic tasks across 17 simulated real-world apps and explicitly surfaces inefficient trajectories, high action overhead and budget exhaustion across 19 GUI agents. Useful agent-runtime evaluation infrastructure rather than a direct optimization.

historical_watchlist.title: Geometric Distributional Control: Learning Progress with Partial Structural Knowledge
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / real-time control / partial-model planning
historical_watchlist.why: GDC factorizes real-time control into a known feasibility scaffold plus a learned local progress signal, avoiding full global Bellman recursion or a fully specified online planner. Protected Physical-AI control/runtime lineage; experiments show effectiveness but the abstract lacks direct latency or compute savings.

historical_watchlist.title: TaskGuard: Task-Conditioned Restoration Utility for Risk-Aware Object Detection
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / adaptive perception / conditional preprocessing
historical_watchlist.why: TaskGuard is a post-hoc controller for frozen restoration+detection pipelines that predicts whether a restoration intervention should be used. It reduces harmful restoration interventions by 54.2% macro and 37.0% pooled while retaining 98.8% of Always-Restore AP, providing useful conditional-perception lineage and a path to skip unnecessary preprocessing.

historical_watchlist.title: HLSFactory-Agent: Large-Scale Agentic HLS Dataset Construction from Academic and Open-Source Projects
historical_watchlist.topic: GPU kernel/DSL/compilers / hardware design agents / HLS infrastructure
historical_watchlist.why: HLSFactory-Agent runs an open-source coding-agent stack in Docker to extract, build and evaluate standalone HLS designs from larger repositories and pairs this with architecture/EDA/FPGA paper indexing. Useful agentic compiler/hardware infrastructure lineage, though current evidence is dataset-construction automation rather than model inference efficiency.

historical_watchlist.title: Efficient and Robust Camera-independent Multiview 3D Geometric Reconstruction from Noisy Monocular Depth Estimation and Multiple Point Matching
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / efficient 3D perception / camera-independent reconstruction
historical_watchlist.why: Uses a camera-independent linear geometric autoregression matrix learned from multi-frame point correspondences; can exploit fast-but-noisy monocular depth and avoids camera-pose recovery. Useful lightweight 3D-perception lineage, but the abstract gives no end-to-end latency or FLOP reduction.

historical_watchlist.title: World Models Under Asynchronous Sensor Observations
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / world models / asynchronous sensing
historical_watchlist.why: Directly studies transformer world models when physical sensor channels arrive at heterogeneous rates. Staleness and time-to-refresh features avoid fabricating interpolated observations or discarding faster sensors, with evaluation in locomotion, MPC and a latched-actuator system. Protected Physical-AI/world-model systems lineage; no direct compute-speedup claim.

historical_watchlist.title: Efficient Fairness Auditing Across Guidance Scales in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Causal Abstraction
historical_watchlist.why: Replaces repeated exhaustive generation across classifier-free-guidance settings with a causal abstraction and probabilistic-transformer predictor over abstract denoising states. The paper explicitly evaluates computational efficiency, making it relevant as amortized diffusion-evaluation lineage, but the abstract reports no numerical speedup.

historical_watchlist.title: AutoLR: Automating the Path from Research to Launch Review in Industrial Recommender Systems
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / autonomous ML engineering / production experimentation
historical_watchlist.why: NetEase production agent harness coordinates multi-day research-to-launch cycles with deterministic controllers retaining authority over execution, metric extraction, guardrails and persistent state. Important long-running agent/ML-infra lineage, though the abstract does not quantify wall-clock savings.

historical_watchlist.title: Learning to Use Imagination: Progress-Conditioned Future Utilization for World Action Models
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / world action models / adaptive imagination
historical_watchlist.why: ProWAM explicitly models execution progress and uses hierarchical progress-conditioned modulation to vary how imagined future latents are consumed across stages and within a stage. This is directly relevant to adaptive WAM runtime design and avoids treating every imagined future as equally useful, although the abstract reports quality rather than compute savings.

historical_watchlist.title: WM-Craftnet: World Synesthesia Model for Generalizable and Robust Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / recurrent world state / dexterous manipulation
historical_watchlist.why: Uses a Dreamer-style recurrent world-synesthesia state as a deployable visuotactile estimator for closed-loop dexterous control. Real-robot evidence shows substantial robustness/generalization gains and reusable latent physical structure; protected Physical-AI/world-model lineage, not a direct inference-acceleration result.

historical_watchlist.title: SE-GoS: Self-Evolving Graph-of-Skills for Skill Library at Scale
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / scalable skill retrieval / token efficiency
historical_watchlist.why: Training-free evolution of a Graph-of-Skills from execution traces improves retrieval quality while reducing context load. On SkillsBench, a representative round raises reward from 52.4% to 59.4% while reducing input tokens by about one-third relative to full skill loading; directly relevant to scalable agent skill/memory infrastructure.

historical_watchlist.title: $Φ$-Bench: Can Large Language Models Engineer the Infrastructure That Powers Them?
historical_watchlist.topic: GPU kernel/DSL/compilers / LLM infrastructure engineering agents / benchmark
historical_watchlist.why: Benchmark grounded in real code repositories spans kernel completion through long-horizon end-to-end LLM-system optimization, directly measuring whether frontier LLMs can engineer the infrastructure stack. Important agentic AI-infra benchmark lineage, but not itself an efficiency technique.

historical_watchlist.title: PGMT: Perceptive General Motion Tracking for Humanoid Robots
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / humanoid runtime / selective terrain perception
historical_watchlist.why: Physical-AI protected item: PGMT uses motion-conditioned terrain glimpses to selectively encode terrain regions relevant to the current motion and demonstrates zero-shot Unitree G1 deployment over complex real terrain. Selective perception is runtime-relevant, though the paper reports robustness rather than compute savings.

historical_watchlist.title: ArmPoser: Real-Time, Calibration-Free Arm Pose Estimation from Smartwatch IMU
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / edge sensing / real-time pose estimation
historical_watchlist.why: Physical-AI/edge protected item: ArmPoser eliminates coordinate transforms, explicit alignment, and user bone-offset calibration by learning directly in device-native smartwatch coordinates, while matching or exceeding calibrated baselines in real-time deployment studies. Efficiency is workflow/deployment simplification rather than a quantified accelerator result.

historical_watchlist.title: Adaptive Vision-Language Grasping via Composable Foundation Priors and Generalizable Grasp Synthesis
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / modular foundation-model priors / grasp runtime
historical_watchlist.why: AdaRoboVLG decouples a reusable physically grounded grasp base policy from task-dependent foundation-model priors, allowing new spatial/cognitive/temporal priors to be composed without retraining the underlying grasp policy. Protected Physical-AI modular-runtime lineage; abstract claims efficient learning but lacks measured inference savings.

historical_watchlist.title: STyMo: Fast and Controllable Few-Shot Motion Style Transfer
historical_watchlist.topic: video/image generation acceleration / motion generation / rapid adaptation
historical_watchlist.why: Few-shot motion style transfer trains from only seconds of paired data in one to two minutes by decomposing static posture and temporal dynamics, enabling an iterative authoring loop with runtime-controllable style factors. Clear adaptation-time efficiency, though outside core LLM serving.

historical_watchlist.title: Closed-Loop Evaluation of Bird's-Eye-View Maps from Cross-View Transformers as Inputs to Behavior-Cloning Policies
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / closed-loop perception-policy interface / autonomous driving
historical_watchlist.why: Protected Physical-AI systems evidence: evaluates predicted BEV representations as direct policy inputs and shows aggregate perception metrics can diverge from closed-loop task success, identifying route-channel quality as the actual policy bottleneck. Valuable representation/runtime evaluation lineage, not an acceleration result.

historical_watchlist.title: 3DHarnessBench: Probing Agentic 3D-to-Code Capabilities of Frontier Vision-Language Models
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / agentic 3D tool use / benchmark
historical_watchlist.why: Benchmarks frontier VLM agents from passive views through active visual exploration to full Blender function-call interaction, exposing model-dependent gains from richer tool access. Useful agent-harness/tool-use evaluation lineage, though it does not report systems-efficiency savings.

historical_watchlist.title: AURORA: Active Uncertainty-Driven Re-Orientation for In-Hand Reconstruction
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / active perception / adaptive 3D reconstruction
historical_watchlist.why: Protected Physical-AI runtime: uncertainty-novelty next-best-view planning actively acquires only informative observations and uses lightweight geometric fusion. The project reports a reference reconstruction latency of 71.82 s versus 417.13 s for Neural Feels (about 5.8x lower), while explicitly noting hardware/task differences.

historical_watchlist.title: OTTER - Two Transistor - One RRAM Architecture for Reliable In-Memory-Computing in 28 nm CMOS Technology
historical_watchlist.topic: edge/cloud/heterogeneous AI systems / compute-in-memory / RRAM accelerator
historical_watchlist.why: 28 nm CMOS plus TaOx RRAM 2T1R platform demonstrates six-level analog conductance and hardware CIM MACs on a 15x15 crossbar. Relevant accelerator/CIM lineage; abstract emphasizes reliability and circuit operation rather than end-to-end AI speedup.

historical_watchlist.title: Mask Forcing: Improving Autoregressive Video Diffusion Distillation via Dual-Noise Masking Rollout
historical_watchlist.topic: video/image generation acceleration / diffusion distillation / autoregressive video generation
historical_watchlist.why: Improves causal autoregressive video diffusion students distilled from bidirectional teachers using dual-noise spatial-temporal masking during self-rollout. Directly relevant to real-time video diffusion distillation; current abstract emphasizes efficient quality gains but gives no clean latency/speedup number.

historical_watchlist.title: Actuator Dynamics Curricula for Narrow-Viability Tasks in Legged Robot Learning
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / robot policy training / curriculum efficiency
historical_watchlist.why: Protected Physical-AI training lineage: actuator-dynamics curriculum expands the viable exploration region so a quadruped handstand task that fails under fixed identified stiffness becomes trainable and transfers to Boston Dynamics Spot hardware. It improves training feasibility rather than inference speed.

historical_watchlist.title: Environment Evolution for Terminal Agents
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / terminal agents / RL environment infrastructure
historical_watchlist.why: Off-policy environment evolution incrementally raises difficulty and schedules evolved tasks generation by generation, avoiding sole reliance on on-policy rollout synthesis. Long-horizon RL improves Qwen3.6-27B and 35B-A3B by 14.4 and 18.0 points on Terminal-Bench 2.1; relevant agent-training infrastructure, though not an inference-efficiency result.

historical_watchlist.title: Introducing Consort: A Spec-First Agent Framework for Enforced, Test-Driven Development on Live Database Branches
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / coding-agent infrastructure / deterministic orchestration
historical_watchlist.why: Uses a deterministic orchestrator, immutable tests, human-approved gates and live database branches so non-deterministic coding agents cannot bypass engineering controls. Valuable production-agent harness lineage; no measured runtime/token reduction yet.

historical_watchlist.title: AVSplat: Dense-View Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Assist-View Preconditioning
historical_watchlist.why: Uses one lightweight interaction with a small relevance/diversity-selected Assist-View set before global attention, plus occupancy-aware voxel fusion, restoring positive scaling as input views grow. Relevant efficient 3D perception lineage, though abstract lacks wall-clock savings.

historical_watchlist.title: EgoNeMo: Transferable Map of Pedestrian Dynamics via Egocentric LiDAR Scan
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / navigation / transferable scene dynamics
historical_watchlist.why: Infers a transferable continuous map of pedestrian dynamics in unseen environments from a single instantaneous egocentric LiDAR scan, avoiding site-specific trajectory accumulation. Protected Physical-AI world-state lineage; efficiency benefit is data/observation reuse rather than measured inference speed.

historical_watchlist.title: Unifying Physics-Based Humanoid Interaction with a Context-Conditioned Interaction Prior
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / humanoid control / reusable skill prior
historical_watchlist.why: Distills heterogeneous locomotion/manipulation teachers into a shared context-conditioned interaction prior that is reused and adapted for downstream humanoid tasks. Protected Physical-AI modular-policy lineage; no clean inference-speed claim.

historical_watchlist.title: Multi-History-Step SDE Inversion for Image Editing with Superior Regional Awareness
historical_watchlist.topic: diffusion/flow acceleration / image editing / low-step sampling
historical_watchlist.why: Predictor-corrector multi-history-step SDE inversion targets faithful editing with fewer sampling steps and automatic semantic masks without extra user input. Direct diffusion sampling-efficiency mechanism, but abstract does not quantify wall-clock speedup.

historical_watchlist.title: Long-Horizon Language Model Reinforcement Learning via Progressive Point Matching
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / RL post-training / long-horizon credit assignment
historical_watchlist.why: Segment-level progressive point matching provides an unbiased dense reward and is shown theoretically and empirically to scale exponentially more efficiently than sparse outcome rewards on long-horizon tasks; practical version needs only one reference trajectory per task.

historical_watchlist.title: Open-Set Ego-Noise Separation for Legged-Robot Audition via Annotation-Free Adaptation and Pretrained-Model Transfer
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / robot sensing / annotation-efficient adaptation
historical_watchlist.why: Selects ego-noise-dominant clips from unlabeled robot recordings and adapts a pretrained separator without robot-specific manual labels or separately recorded ego-noise-only data. Protected Physical-AI sensing/adaptation lineage.

historical_watchlist.title: Where to Look Matters: Learning Influential Views for VLM-based 3D Visual Grounding
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / active vision / view selection
historical_watchlist.why: Trains a lightweight query-conditioned selector to choose influential camera views before frozen-VLM comparative grounding, replacing fixed visibility heuristics. Relevant adaptive-perception lineage, though accuracy rather than compute is the reported endpoint.

historical_watchlist.title: PRG-Fusion: Orchestrating Generative Priors with Reconstruction Evidence for Driving View Synthesis
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / simulation / region-adaptive generation
historical_watchlist.why: Routes regions among 3DGS preservation, LiDAR-guided repair, and video-prior generation according to reconstruction evidence. Protected Physical-AI simulation lineage with explicit region-adaptive compute semantics; current abstract emphasizes quality rather than latency.

historical_watchlist.title: Flow3D-OPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for 3D Geometry Generation with Flow-Matching Diffusion Transformer
historical_watchlist.why: Uses multi-teacher on-policy distillation and hard task routing to consolidate specialized flow-matching 3D teachers into one student while mitigating gradient interference. Relevant flow-distillation lineage; no measured inference acceleration in abstract.

historical_watchlist.title: Parser-Free VLM Verification for Federated Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
historical_watchlist.topic: multimodal/MLLM serving / selective inference / federated edge AI
historical_watchlist.why: Trains only a compact MIL scorer across clients and invokes a frozen 2B VLM only on high-scoring suspect segments; next-token Yes/No logits avoid full text generation and parsers. Useful selective-VLM/edge-inference lineage, though system latency is not quantified.

historical_watchlist.title: Re-engineering SORT-based algorithms for low-cost small object tracking from omnidirectional footage
historical_watchlist.topic: edge/cloud/heterogeneous AI systems / lightweight tracking / CPU inference
historical_watchlist.why: Re-engineers SORT geometry for omnidirectional footage without ReID or transformer appearance encoders; the tracking stage stays CPU-only while improving HOTA/MOTA/IDF1 on the target benchmark.

historical_watchlist.title: Learning to Fly: Stable Vision-Guided UAV Servoing with Compact Target-Centric Cues and Reinforcement Learning
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / UAV control / compact perception
historical_watchlist.why: Replaces direct high-dimensional RGB policy input with lightweight target segmentation and a compact 12D observation combining image-space cues and proprioception. Protected Physical-AI adaptive-perception lineage; abstract reports robustness rather than measured compute savings.

historical_watchlist.title: NeoHorse-1: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement via Agentic Post-Training with Routing Harness
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / routing harness / post-training infrastructure
historical_watchlist.why: Uses a heterogeneous model pool plus intelligent routing to record capability demand, chosen service tier and tool/harness traces, then converts them into validated curricula and routing-guided on-policy distillation. Relevant agent-infra feedback-loop lineage.

historical_watchlist.title: EdMCGS: Event-Driven Markov Chain Gaussian Splatting for Extreme-Low-Frame-Rate Dynamic Scene Reconstruction
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / 3DGS / real-time dynamic reconstruction
historical_watchlist.why: Event-driven control points propagate motion between sparse RGB frames and render dynamic scenes in real time using far fewer Gaussians than the strongest event-based baseline. Direct efficient 3D scene-representation lineage; abstract lacks a comparable wall-clock number.

historical_watchlist.title: Distillation as Probability Transport: Routed On-Policy Distillation
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / distillation / RL post-training
historical_watchlist.why: RouteOPD turns sampled on-policy distillation into explicit teacher-guided probability transport, directing updates only from student-excess sources to teacher-deficit destinations and improving reasoning benchmarks with lower background leakage.

historical_watchlist.title: Temporal State Transport in Video Generation: Diagnosing and Correcting Spectral Imbalance
historical_watchlist.topic: video/image generation acceleration / training-free video control
historical_watchlist.why: Introduces a training-free regulator that selectively corrects only pathological temporal-attention states while largely preserving balanced states, improving temporal consistency without finetuning. Useful adaptive-compute/control lineage, though runtime overhead is not quantified.

historical_watchlist.title: CLAMP: Constrained Decoding for Vision-Language Embodied Planning
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / embodied planning / constrained decoding
historical_watchlist.why: Uses scene evidence and a symbolic action model to hard-mask infeasible next tokens and HMM lookahead to reweight feasible actions for a frozen VLM planner. Protected Physical-AI decoding/runtime lineage with no model retraining.

historical_watchlist.title: Difficulty-Adaptive Tree-Structured Policy Optimization for Expanding Reasoning Coverage in RLVR
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / RLVR / adaptive rollouts
historical_watchlist.why: Difficulty-adaptive tree rollouts and entropy-guided branching allocate training exploration according to problem difficulty and improve pass@k/test-time scaling. Direct adaptive-rollout efficiency mechanism, but abstract emphasizes reasoning coverage rather than measured training-cost reduction.

historical_watchlist.title: Learning Global Camera Poses from Noisy View-Graphs for Structure from Motion
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / 3D perception / scalable pose estimation
historical_watchlist.why: Permutation-equivariant view-graph aggregation estimates globally consistent camera poses, scales beyond one thousand images and is reported much faster than state-of-the-art classical pipelines. Relevant scalable 3D perception lineage; abstract omits a wall-clock ratio.

historical_watchlist.title: A Risk-Sensitive and Uncertainty-Aware Decision-Making and Control Framework for Safe and Robust Autonomous Driving
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / autonomous driving / adaptive safety runtime
historical_watchlist.why: Uses policy uncertainty to adapt control-barrier strictness and a residual predictor for model mismatch, balancing safety and efficiency while satisfying real-time requirements. Protected Physical-AI runtime lineage rather than a pure acceleration result.

historical_watchlist.title: Beyond Surface Imitation: Contrastive Modeling for Reasoning Path Alignment in Multimodal In-Context Learning
historical_watchlist.topic: multimodal/MLLM serving / adaptive reasoning / early exit
historical_watchlist.why: A lightweight alignment controller predicts response quality and decides whether another self-refinement step is needed, making iterative multimodal ICL conditional rather than unconditional. Relevant adaptive-inference lineage; no latency/token measurement in abstract.

historical_watchlist.title: Odometer-Agnostic Drift Correction Using OpenStreetMap Lane Geometry
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / localization / lightweight runtime

historical_watchlist.title: Harness Robotic OS: A Unified Embodied-Agent Runtime for Closed-Loop Quadruped Inspection

historical_watchlist.title: 2AM: Grounding Agent-Side Memory as Guidance for Steerable Action Models in Long-Horizon Manipulation
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / agent memory / long-horizon manipulation
historical_watchlist.why: Keeps long-horizon task memory entirely in a multimodal Agent while an RGB episodically stateless Action Model executes motion. Structured language and 2D hints raise LIBERO-Mem average completion to 76.3% from a 14.8% reported baseline.

historical_watchlist.title: Taming Bitwise Behavior in GPU Kernels with Tensor Core: Black-Box Reconstruction, Compiler Enforcement, and Static Verification
historical_watchlist.topic: GPU kernel/DSL/compilers / tensor core / deterministic kernels
historical_watchlist.why: Reconstructs GEMM reduction order for closed-source libraries, enforces balanced-tree reduction in Triton, and adds static bit-equivalence checking across PTX and GCN. For realistic LLM fused-epilogue shapes it matches or exceeds torch.compile, while 19 of 27 deterministic kernels stay within 10% of free-order performance.

historical_watchlist.title: ActSafeGuard: Differentiable and Training-Aligned Constraint Enforcement for Flow-Matching Policies
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / flow-policy runtime safety
historical_watchlist.why: A differentiable safeguard layer integrates hard action feasibility into training for flow-matching policies. Across pi_0.5 and Fast-WAM backbones it reports 100% step safety while preserving or improving task success, making it a protected Physical-AI runtime/safety lineage rather than an inference-speed result.

historical_watchlist.title: HuRo: Robotizing Human Videos for Scalable VLA Pretraining
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / scalable VLA data and pretraining
historical_watchlist.why: HuRo converts heterogeneous human videos into robot-aligned observations and retargeted actions, yielding about 630K robotized episodes and 142M frames. Scaling robotized pretraining improves real-world completion from 51.5% to 80.3% and OOD completion from 34.9% to 72.2%; retained under the Physical-AI protection rule as scalable VLA-training lineage.

historical_watchlist.title: UniMPA: A Unified Memory-Prediction-Action Model via Action-Grounded Transition Modeling
historical_watchlist.why: UniMPA uses persistent/selective future prediction plus temporal visual-action and action-visual memory banks to ground predicted transitions in executable experience. It is a protected Physical-AI memory/action-model lineage; current abstract evidence emphasizes capability rather than runtime speed.

historical_watchlist.title: Rapid Learning of Dexterous In-Hand Pen Writing through Real-Time Jacobian Estimation
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / dexterous control / low-compute adaptation
historical_watchlist.why: Physical-robot controller starts after about 18 s initialization, runs on laptop CPU only, adapts online without simulation training or pre-collected demonstrations, and reaches mean 0.6 mm precision. Strong protected Physical-AI efficiency signal, but not an AI inference acceleration method.

historical_watchlist.title: Caption-once, Frames-on-Demand: Visual-Need Routing for Budget-Aware Agentic Long Video Understanding
historical_watchlist.topic: multimodal/MLLM serving / agent systems / edge-cloud / adaptive visual compute
historical_watchlist.why: Builds a reusable caption index once and uses a query-conditioned Visual-Need Router to fetch bounded keyframes only when pixels are needed, explicitly capping per-query frame consumption independent of video length. historical_watchlist.title: RetroThinker: Enabling Retrospective Thinking in Speech LLMs
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / streaming speech LLM / latency-quality tradeoff
historical_watchlist.why: Streaming SpeechLLM revises reasoning online and reports +11% absolute GSM8K accuracy at comparable latency versus non-retrospective baselines. Relevant latency-aware reasoning lineage, but no direct throughput or latency reduction.

historical_watchlist.title: Model-Aware Schedules Improve Generation via Fiberwise Optimal Transport
historical_watchlist.why: Model-aware schedule allocation improves flow-matching quality by 38.6% relative FID at 16 function evaluations and a frozen analytic template retains most gains. Useful fixed-compute diffusion/flow efficiency lineage, though not a measured wall-clock accelerator.

historical_watchlist.title: Data Scarcity and Model Sparsity: Mixtures-of-Experts Overfit More to Repeated Data
historical_watchlist.why: Shows sparse MoEs lose their efficiency advantage faster than dense models under repeated data and that strong masking regularization can preserve the MoE advantage beyond 64x repetition. Important efficiency boundary condition for sparse-model training, but not a systems acceleration contribution.

historical_watchlist.title: EVPeriscope: Extended Perception across Aerial and Ground Vehicles with Event-based Propeller Tracking
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / edge perception / heterogeneous robots
historical_watchlist.why: Event-based ground-aerial perception runs closed-loop quadrotor control at 200 Hz entirely with onboard sensing and computation, including challenging field conditions. Protected edge Physical-AI runtime evidence; not a foundation-model acceleration method.

historical_watchlist.title: FARM: Reading Failure Signals from the Internal Predictive States of a Frozen Robotic World Model
historical_watchlist.topic: VLA/WAM/Physical AI serving / world-model monitoring / low-overhead runtime
historical_watchlist.why: Uses only a 33,985-parameter readout over frozen VLA-JEPA predictive states for online failure monitoring. Across real robots it supports fixed-readout transfer/readout-only adaptation and adds only 0.2256 ms mean CUDA latency once the frozen state is available. Protected Physical-AI runtime evidence.

historical_watchlist.title: ChurnBench: A Drift-Aware Benchmark Demonstrating That Refresh Scheduling, Not Cache Age, Governs Staleness in Agentic AI
historical_watchlist.topic: efficient reasoning/agent systems / cache freshness / retrieval runtime
historical_watchlist.why: Open-source drift-aware agent benchmark shows refresh scheduling, not nominal cache age, controls freshness errors: disabling tiered refresh raises errors from 4 to 45 at 28 days while one-day results remain identical. High-value agent-cache lifecycle evidence, but not a direct accelerator.

historical_watchlist.title: ZipCodec: Ultra-Low-Frame-Rate Streaming Speech Coding
historical_watchlist.topic: multimodal/MLLM serving / streaming speech / token-rate reduction

historical_watchlist.title: Why Does Post-Training Quantization Work?
historical_watchlist.why: Explains pretrained LLM quantization robustness through layerwise error cancellation and LM-head geometry that preserves high-ranked token scores. Important PTQ mechanism/lineage result across models and quantization settings, but not a new acceleration algorithm.

historical_watchlist.title: ORCH: Organizational Principles Enable Collective Intelligence in Embodied AI

Protected Physical-AI orchestration lineage; gains are mission-level rather than model-inference speedup.

historical_watchlist.title: The Battery Price of edge AI: A study of the Environmental Impact of LLM Inference on Mobile Devices

This is useful evidence for avoiding a misleading MLLM cache-compression heuristic, but not a new acceleration mechanism.

historical_watchlist.title: One Simple Trick for Improving the Performance of Energy-Limited Local Inference and Training

historical_watchlist.why: Shows that finer alternation of compute- and memory-bound work can smooth power/temperature spikes and reduce throttling on DGX Spark, with up to about 2% performance and energy improvement. historical_watchlist.title: RunningTensor: Generalizing Linear Attention to Higher-Order Recurrent States
